title: The Secret Engineering Behind Honeybee Climate Control
description: Discover how a honeybee colony operates as a single superorganism, fighting extreme heat and freezing winters to protect their hive.
instagram_caption:
A shift of just a few degrees is a death sentence. 🌡️ Discover how honeybees work as a collective superorganism to heat and cool their hive, defying the elements! 🐝✨

#nature #insects #science #wildlife #honeybees #biology

segments.narration: A shift of just a few degrees is a death sentence for an entire honeybee colony.
To keep their developing larvae alive and prevent their wax home from melting, bees must maintain a precise ninety-five degrees.
To fight back against summer heat, hundreds of worker bees line up, synchronizing their wings to fan hot air out.

segments.narration: But the real test comes when winter arrives and temperatures plunge far below freezing.
broll_queries: snowy wooden beehive winter close up

segments.narration: The bees huddle into a tight ball, vibrating their massive flight muscles to generate pure friction heat and defy the cold.
